---
title: "Provenance and Data Boundaries"
---

## Public provenance contract

A run or report binds, as applicable:

- SCGSim and backend revision;
- SGB source and geometry/topology identity;
- solver and schema version;
- machine profile and run receipt;
- config, mesh, handoff, result, and report artifact identities;
- validation and failure state.

The current source-lane identities are recorded in
[Goals and upstream relationship](goals-and-upstream.qmd#starting-source-identities).

## Publication boundary

Public SCGSim documentation and fixtures must contain no private names, paths,
dimensions, screenshots, meshes, configs, receipts, data, or artifacts.
Sanitization alone does not grant publication authority.

Private consumer validation may inform a public aggregate statement only when
the statement has separate publication authority and contains no private
identity or payload.
